correctness.rationale: A family of chosen pairs with induced Kneser maximum degree <=1 either lies in ordinary pairwise-intersecting B_n or contains disjoint A,B; every remaining pair meets both A,B, hence belongs to the same four-symbol Q (Frankl–Kupavskii Claim 7 supplies known containment). Ordinary B_n is built from star simplices with nerve K_n plus triangle 2-cells, giving skel_2 Delta^(n-1) via triangle attaching loops. For each 4-set Q, the 5-simplex D_Q meets B_n in the octahedral S2 and meets other D_R only in B_n; its fundamental attaching cycle maps to the alternating tetrahedral boundary. Hurewicz for the simply connected 2-skeleton permits replacing the 3-cell attaching map by that boundary. Therefore full skel3 and wedge. Integral oriented relative 3-chains have alternating Q sign, boundary contraction by the sum functional, so kernel = wedge^4 V_n. Independent exact finite face enumerations n=4,...,8 yielded sphere counts 0,1,5,15,35; source verification n=6 includes complete matching and all 720 characters. General proof rather than finite extrapolation covers all n.
residual_risks: The homotopy equivalence is not asserted Sn-equivariant; only integral homology has the natural module. Finite enumeration does not prove all n, which instead relies on the union/pushout argument.
